management_remarks: TCS delivered a resilient start in Q1 FY25 with broad-based sequential growth across major markets and a strong Total Contract Value (TCV) order book of USD 8.3 billion. Our industry-leading operating EBIT margin stood at 24.7% even after absorbing annual wage increments, demonstrating unmatched operational rigor and utilization efficiency. Generative AI and cloud modernization pipeline doubled sequentially to USD 1.5 billion, reinforcing TCS's position as the strategic transformation partner of choice.
analyst_qa: In Q&A on discretionary IT spending, management noted that client decision cycles remain cautious and uncertain, with non-essential consulting projects subject to budget reprioritization. Short-cycle ramp-downs in select North America communications and retail accounts continue to create near-term revenue headwinds that are challenging to offset immediately. We maintain a calibrated hiring posture as quarterly demand visibility remains volatile.
